qa_pair.question: Use the parsing tool on "דחוף להגיש היום, 20 דקות". What urgency score is returned? Answer with one integer.
Use the parsing tool on "Read a chapter" in English. How many default minutes are assigned? Answer with one integer.
Organize "urgent call today, 10 min; read, 20 min" with 25 available minutes from 10:00. How many minutes remain? Answer with one integer.
Organize "late task, 30 min" with 30 minutes from 23:50. What HH:MM end time is returned?
Parse "להמתין, שעתיים". What duration in minutes is returned? Answer with one integer.
Parse "P1 submit, 30 min" in English. What urgency bucket is returned? Answer high, medium, or low.
Organize one 15-minute task with zero available minutes. How many tasks are scheduled? Answer with one integer.
Parse an input containing only whitespace and bullets. What warning code is returned?
Parse "Long task, 30 hours" in English. What duration in minutes is returned after safety capping? Answer with one integer.
Parse two identical lines "לשתות מים". How many tasks are returned? Answer with one integer.
